profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at DMI (Digital Management, LLC)
profile.summary:
Senior Java Developer with experience in Web applications development using J2EE platform. Experienced in object oriented analysis & design using UML to obtain functional and non functional requirements of projects. Great communication and customer service skills. With experience in managing teams, problem solving, and planning,   Proactive, works closely with business users and project team members during all phases of the process including requirement, design, development and user acceptance. Industrious, trouble shooter, thrives on a challenge, works effectively with all levels. Ethical and loyal, maintains a high degree of confidentiality.  Highly motivated and seeking new challenges.

Specialties: Software analysis, design, development, testing, integration and deployment of enterprise systems using JEE platform (JAWS, Axis 2.0, SOA,  JSP, Servlets, EJB 2.0, JDBC, Java Server Faces 2.0, Flex2.0, Struts2.0, Spring3.0, Hibernate3.0). Modeling with UML,  database Oracle9i, Sybase, MS SQL Server and DB2 UDB, PL/SQL, DML and DDL, writing Complex SQL.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: XML Schema Definition (XSD) · RESTful WebServices · Git · AWS Database Migration Service · Amazon Aurora · Spring Boot · Node.js · MySQL · Datadog · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes · Liquibase · WebSphere Application Server · AWS CloudFormation · Amazon EC2 · Microservices · Amazon S3 · Mockito · Amazon Dynamodb · Docker Products · TypeScript · Microsoft Azure · PostgreSQL · OpenLiberty · Oracle Database · HTML · AWS Lambda · IBM Db2 · AWS Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM)

positions.title: Java Developer Senior
positions.description:
Analyze the root cause of software problems 
Best troubleshooting based on business rules 
Fix bugs on SSP module. 
Used integrated environment of IBM Rational Application Developer. 
Arranged and involved sessions to discuss lesson learnt and best practices.

positions.title: Team Lead and Programmer
positions.description:
Coordinate UAT testing with the areas involved. 
Configure security server queues.  
Configure self-signed certificate security in Web Services.  
Implement security in Web Services consumer and producer. 
Fix bugs on modules sending, receiving and tracking. 
Design and development of front end components using Java Server Pages (JSP). 
Create Web Service clients to consume service offered by other systems. 
Create Web Service to save messages from other systems to DB and queues. 
JUnits is used for unit testing. 
Used integrated environment of Eclipse. 
Arranged and involved sessions to discuss lesson learnt and best practices. 
Development of XPath component to read and fill XML service request.
Development JavaBeans components under BPO architecture designed by Hildebrando. 
Design and documentation process flow. 
Setting up development, testing and work environments. 
Communication with requirements, architecture and testing teams. 
Creation of new business account for the policy which includes creation of pay plans etc. 
Supports policy amendments, renewals, non-renewals cancellations, reinstate and rescind. 
Create bills, statements of account and all related notices to customers. 
Maintain billing accounts for customers’ that reflect all financial transactions. 
Provide customers with a choice of multiple, flexible payment plans as well a customized billing.

positions.title: Information Specialist Senior
positions.description:
At the Tax Refund Withholdings and Offsets project has three phases and the first phase is in produce, and nowadays the second stage is in QA department to be tested by client.

Design, codding and maintenance of Datawarehouse and External Web Services.
Design and coding Confirmation ticket to Taxpayers as a part of an integral solution to SAT at first stage.

Design, codding of Offsets management module as a part of an integral solution to SAT in second and third stages. 

Design of testing case close to Quality Assurance.

positions.title: Consultor Especialista Senior
positions.description:
Gathering requirements from customers.
Analyze requirements and converting them into technical specifications.
Fixing timelines to complete assignments with support of project leader.
Analyze & design best solutions to add and improve functionality for Commissions Agent’s Reports Management module, Dynamic Commissions Balance Statement Summary module and Commissions Agent’s payments.
Develop of new components to Commissions Agent’s Reports Management module, Dynamic Commissions Balance Statement Summary module and Commissions Agent’s payments module.
Develop and manage a Quality Assurance roadmap.
Preparation of test cases for developed modules using JUnit.
Resolve technical problems.
Mapping Sybase and Oracle tables using Hibernate2.0.
Mapping JavaBeans components and JSP in Struts 2.0 framework.
Develop new java components (java classes, JavaBeans, DAO’s, java processes’ on backend).
Develop web pages using JSP, Java Server Faces

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Checking connection classes of SOI system
Setup of connections pool in BEA WebLogic 8.1
Modify JSP.
Improve performance of queries.
Modify java classes to replace JDBC connections by connections pool.
Eliminate redundant java code from connection class.
Coordinate meetings with HP support to get documentation about his API.
Develop new java components (java classes, JavaBeans, Dao’s, java processe's on backend).
Setup Struts 1.2 to work with SQL Server 2000.
Develop presentation tier using JSP 
Develop components to generate reports of services communication equipment, service status and so on.
Deploy application on JBOSS.

positions.title: Líder Senior de Proyectos
positions.description: Desarrollo de aplicaciones desktop y web para la solicitud de becas nacionales e internacionales, así como becas SNI y post doctorales
